newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan government detains former diplomat.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan government detains former diplomat.

text.p: Pakistan federal investigators on Tuesday detained the country's former high commissioner to Britain, Wajid Shamsul Hasan, on unspecified charges, a government official said.
Family sources said Hasan was picked up from his Karachi residence by the Federal Investigation Agency (FIA) without any formal charges.
An FIA official said Hasan was being held pending further instructions from the government.
"We have asked him to come and see some sensitive documents and we are awaiting instructions from higher officials in Islamabad for further orders," said the official, who asked not to be named.
Hasan, a former Karachi newspaper editor, served as Pakistan's High Commissioner in London under deposed Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto.
He was in Pakistan when Bhutto's government was dismissed on November 5 by President Farooq Leghari on charges of corruption and misrule.
He was prevented from leaving the country on November 17 to formally hand over his position to the new high commissioner in London.
Hasan last week had filed a lawsuit against the caretaker government challenging his sacking. The government has sought until December 13 to respond.
